zh.summary: 官方插件市场默认开启并接入 Awesome DSH 目录，内核更新不再要求先升级 Portable，安装包自带内核升到官方 0.2.1-rc.2。
highlights: 插件市场：官方的「发现」页默认开启，并预装了 Awesome DSH 目录（几千个社区插件）。卡片显示近 30 天下载量、年下载量、星标和预览图；点预览图可放大，多张图可以翻页；可按默认顺序、发布时间、近 30 天下载量、年下载量、星标排序。从目录安装的插件也能在这里更新和回滚。
「高级管理」改为只打开已安装页：分组、更新与回滚、主题、诊断和修复工具；浏览和安装统一在官方「发现」页。
内核更新：内核包现在按「外壳接口版本」匹配，不再绑定某个具体的 Portable 版本。不跟进 Portable 发布的用户也能收到新内核；装内核时保留外壳自己的版本和预装插件清单，换内核前会先用新内核检查你已安装的插件，加载不了就取消并回滚，版本范围对不上会在更新后列出。需要新接口时会提示先更新 DSH-Portable。0.9.1 及更早的版本不认识这个机制，需要先升到 0.9.2 一次。
内核：安装包自带的官方内核升到 0.2.1-rc.2。预装的图片查看器 0.1.15、会话管理 1.5.16 已适配。历史会话迁移已在真实内核上验证。
插件市场修复：卸载插件时会先记下它写入的配置行再删除，不再留下无用配置行；下载源还没同步到新版本时会明确提示“稍后重试”；下载量数据被限流时只补取缺的那几批，不再让下载量大的插件整天排在最后。
upgradeNotes: 升级会保留设置、会话、插件和默认工作区。整包更新后会自动恢复你选的内核。
已有用户升级后，官方「发现」页和 Awesome DSH 目录会自动出现一次；在插件页关掉它或移除目录源，之后不会再被改回去。

en.summary: The official plugin market is on by default with the Awesome DSH catalog, core updates no longer require upgrading Portable first, and the bundled official core moves to 0.2.1-rc.2.
highlights: Plugin market: the official Discover page is on by default, with the Awesome DSH catalog (thousands of community plugins) preinstalled. Cards show 30-day downloads, yearly downloads, stars and a preview; click a preview to enlarge it and page through every image; sort by default order, release date, 30-day downloads, yearly downloads or stars. Plugins installed from the catalog can be updated and rolled back there too.
Advanced now opens only the installed view: groups, update and rollback, themes, diagnostics and repair tools. Browsing and installing live on the official Discover page.

Core updates: a core package now matches on the shell interface version rather than one exact Portable version, so users who do not follow Portable releases still receive new cores. Installing a core keeps the shell's own version and preinstalled plugin list. Before switching, your installed plugins are checked against the new core: if they cannot load the update is cancelled and rolled back, and plugins whose version ranges no longer fit are listed afterwards. When a new interface is required you are asked to update DSH-Portable first. 0.9.1 and earlier do not know this mechanism and need to move to 0.9.2 once.

Core: the official core bundled in the installer moves to 0.2.1-rc.2. The preinstalled Image Viewer 0.1.15 and Chat Manager 1.5.16 are adapted to it. Historical session migration was verified on the real core.

Plugin market fixes: uninstalling a plugin records the config rows it inserted before deleting it, so no orphan rows remain; a release your download mirror has not synced yet says to retry later; when download counts are rate-limited only the missing batches are retried, so heavily downloaded plugins no longer sort last for the whole day.
upgradeNotes: Upgrading keeps settings, sessions, plugins, and the default workspace. After a full update your chosen core is restored automatically.
Existing users get the official Discover page and the Awesome DSH catalog once after upgrading; if you turn it off on the Plugins page or remove the catalog source, it is not switched back.
